Yukana Yame, the girl in question, is disgusted by Junichi's groveling. However, through a series of teasing remarks, she soon finds herself bonding with him and ultimately accepting Junichi's confession, much to his surprise.

Hajimete no Gal follows Junichi as he overcomes his lack of self-confidence and suppresses his sexual urges, all while thrust into a whole new school life full of lively girls and unpredictable mayhem.
275302.seasonTitle: My First Girlfriend is a Gal
episodeTitles: My First Time Begging for It

275303.title: From a calm tomorrow
275303.evaluate:
People in the past lived in the world in the sea, and could breathe and live in the sea. However, people who longed for land abandon the sea and the feather garments given by the sea god. Humans are gradually divided into humans living in the sea and humans living on land. People who originally communicated with each other in the same way have different ideas as time goes by. 
 Four young girls living in the sea-Hikari Maeshima, Aika Mukai, Chisaki Hiragira, and Isaki. They were transferred to Mihama Middle School on the land because of the abolition of Boro Middle School of Shikao Haimura, where they met a boy born on land, Kihara Bosu, and they met.

275314.title: Muscle girl: How many kilograms can you lift with dumbbells?
275314.seasonTitle: Muscle girl: How many kilograms can you lift with dumbbells?

275318.title: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter
275318.evaluate: Noir is the son of a minor noble with very little to his name other than a job offer—which is canceled before he can even start his first day. He does possess one rare trait, though: the magical ability to consult with a great sage, even if using the skill gives him terrible headaches! Unsure of what his future holds, he accesses the sage for advice on how to move forward and is directed to a secret dungeon filled with rare beasts and magical items. It is here that Noir will train, compiling experience and wealth, until he's powerful enough to change his fate.
275318.seasonTitle: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter

275319.title: Redo of Healer
275319.evaluate:
"Healing magicians cannot fight alone."

Keare, who was bound by this common knowledge, was exploited again and again by others. One day, he noticed what lay beyond healing magic, and was convinced that a healing magician was the strongest class. However, by the time he realized that potential, he was deprived of everything. Thus, he used healing magic on the world itself to go back four years, deciding to redo everything.

This is a heroic tale of one healing magician who became the strongest by using knowledge from his past life and healing magic.

275320.title: World Witches Take Off!
275320.evaluate: Countries all over the world formed an alliance to counter the emerging enemy of mankind "Neuroi," whom only girls with special powers could counter. However, the Neuroi never appeared. Instead of fighting, the witches spend their days idly. This time following not only unit 501, but also unit 502 known as "Brave Witches!" The 2nd volume of the comical daily drama of the witches who do not fight Neuroi begins!
episodeTitles: Miyafuji, Are You Making a Movie?

275321.title: Project Scard: Scar on the Praeter
275321.evaluate:
Project Scard depicts the encounters and battles of those who have tattoos which possess the sealed powers of divine beasts and gods. The story is set in the Akatsuki Special Zone, a lawless zone in Tokyo.

"Helios" are those who use the ability of the tattoos to protect the city, "Artemis" are committed to maintain security and control, whilst having a strong commercial motive, and the "Public Security Special Service" are Scard Staff of the metropolitan police department. They live through the turbulent days to keep on going.
275321.seasonTitle: Project Scard: Scar on the Praeter
episodeTitles: Project Scard: Scar on the Praeter

275322.title: Non Non Biyori Nonstop
275322.evaluate: The third season of Non Non Biyori.

275340.title: O Maidens in Your Savage Season
275340.seasonTitle: O Maidens in Your Savage Season
episodeTitles: The Taste of Her Pork Miso Soup

275360.title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann
275360.evaluate:
Simon boy who lives in an underground village is used to the all-day-digging life in the underground village until Kamina, a free-spirited loose cannon bent on making a name for himself.

One day while excavating the earth, Simon stumbles upon a mysterious object that turns out to be the ignition key to an ancient artifact of war, which the duo dubs Lagann. Using their new weapon, Simon and Kamina fend off a surprise attack from the surface to wander the world above.

275361.title: Tanaka-kun is Always Listless
275361.evaluate: For high school student Tanaka, the act of being listless is a way of life. Known for his inattentiveness and ability to fall asleep anywhere, Tanaka prays that each day will be as uneventful as the last, seeking to preserve his lazy lifestyle however he can by avoiding situations that require him to exert himself. Along with his dependable friend Oota who helps him with tasks he is unable to accomplish, the lethargic teenager constantly deals with events that prevent him from experiencing the quiet and peaceful days he longs for.

275368.title: Shomin Sample
275368.evaluate: Kimito Kagurazaka is a commoner with a fetish for men's muscles—or at least that's the lie he must keep telling if he wants to keep himself out of trouble at the elite all-girls school, Seikain Academy. Kidnapped by the school under the assumption that he prefers men, Kimito is made to be their "commoner sample," exposing the girls to both commoner and man so that the transition to the world after school is not jarring. Threatened with castration should his sexual preferences not match the school's assumptions, Kimito keeps up the facade to protect his manhood.
episodeTitles: Reiko Is Who We Wish to Be Like
It Was Like the Garden of Eden

275370.title: OreShura
275370.evaluate:
The infidelity of Eita Kidou's parents not only made his family fall apart, but also made him skeptic of love. Having no intention to delve into romance, Eita devotes his entire high school life to his studies in order to become a doctor.
It did not take long for the beautiful and popular Masuzu Natsukawa to notice Eita's apathy. Tired of being the object of people's affection, she asks him to pretend to be her boyfriend, as she too feels disgusted at the notion of love. Eita, however, refuses—yet Masuzu has one trick left up her sleeve: Eita’s journal and threatening to post the embarrassing content online if he does not comply.
episodeTitles: The Start of My High School Life is a Battleground
Starting a New Club is a Battleground
A Battleground over the Tears of a Childhood Friend

275371.title: The tale of the headless horseman
275371.evaluate:
Tokyo, Ikebukuro. 
The young Ryanomine Teijin who yearned for urban life accepted an invitation from his friend Masaomi Kida, who had played with him since childhood, to leave his hometown and come to Tokyo to enter Ikebukuro Raira Academy. 
And in Ikebukuro, there are a few people who can't provoke, especially Shizuo Heiwajima, who is known as the "strongest" and Rinya Orihara, who runs the information house. In addition, there is an unidentified violent organization called "Dollars" in Ikebukuro. 
 However, on the first day in Beijing, Teijin, who was disturbed by the complicated relationship in Ikebukuro, witnessed the urban legend "Headless Horseman"-Selti Stroud, riding a black motorcycle through the streets. Elson. 
 So, as the slasher incidents occurred one after another in Ikebukuro, Heiwajima Shizuo, Orihara Rinya, Dollars, Headless Horseman, Slasher, Yellow Turban, etc. gradually surfaced around the "Who is the strongest in Ikebukuro". The topic, Ikebukuro is facing collapse, a series of abnormal but straightforward stories began.
275371.seasonTitle: The tale of the headless horseman

275372.title: Servamp
275372.evaluate:
When a stray black cat named Kuro crosses Mahiru Shirota's path, the high school freshman's life will never be the same again. Kuro is, in fact, no ordinary feline, but a "servamp" - a servant vampire.

While Mahiru's personal philosophy is one of non-intervention, he soon becomes embroiled in an ancient, altogether surreal conflict between vampires and humans.
episodeTitles: About the Future That Never Came

275373.title: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden
275373.evaluate: The Servamps and their pact-bound "Eves" are finally getting back to their normal lives as they recover from their injuries from the previous battles. However, when it starts snowing in the middle of summer, one of the Eves, Mahiru Shirota, suspects vampiric interference. Concerned by the strange phenomenon, he sets out to gather the group once more to try and solve the mystery; however, they suddenly lose contact with Misono Arisuin, the Eve of the Servamp of Lust.
275373.seasonTitle: Servamp Movie: Alice in the Garden

275375.title: Love song dedicated to a certain pilot
275375.seasonTitle: Love song dedicated to a certain pilot

275390.title: Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san
275390.evaluate:
Once a hot springs inn, now a boarding house with extraordinarily cheap rent, Yuragi-sou is virtually uninhabited save for a few peculiar residents. As rumor has it, it is haunted by a vile ghost which scares away all potential tenants. Therefore, it is the perfect refuge for Fuyuzora Kogarashi—a broke, homeless psychic seeking an affordable roof to stay under and ghosts to exorcise.

Kogarashi prepares for a face-off against the ghost, only to find out it is not as malicious as the rumors made it out to be. Instead, it is the ghost of a beautiful, silver-haired girl whose only recollection of her life before death is her name: Yuuna. Even more baffling is that the other tenants of Yuragi-sou not only are able to see Yuuna as well, but each has their own supernatural ability.

Amidst the chaos caused by his quirky fellow residents, Kogarashi attempts to uncover the regret that keeps Yuuna anchored to the world of the living, lest she become an evil spirit sentenced to spend her afterlife in hell.

275391.title: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life
275391.evaluate: Gen Kudou, a koto maker, believes that his delinquent grandson Chika would never understand the profoundness of the traditional musical instrument. In an attempt to make up for his naivety and understand the words of his late grandfather, Chika tries to join the Tokise High School Koto Club.
275391.seasonTitle: Kono Oto Tomare!: Sounds of Life

275392.title: One Week Friends
275392.evaluate: Kaori Fujimiya is always alone because all of her happy memories, including time spent with her friends, disappear every Monday. Deciding that he wants to be friends with her anyway, Yuuki Hase tries to get close to Kaori each week, wishing that she would one day call him "a friend."

275394.title: Ginga Kikoutai Majestic Prince Movie: Kakusei no Idenshi
275394.evaluate: In the latter half of 21st century, humans leave the Earth and begin to live in space. In order to adapt to the environment in space and deal with the hostile aliens in Jupiter, genetically engineered children called "Princes" are artificially raised and trained to be pilots of armed robots "AHSMB (Advanced High Standard Multipurpose Battle Device). This is a story about one of the teenage "Princes," Hitachi O Izuru, who studies in an academic city Grandzehle.
275394.seasonTitle: Ginga Kikoutai Majestic Prince Movie: Kakusei no Idenshi

275395.title: The Legend of Galactic Heroes Die Neue These Encounters
275395.seasonTitle: The Legend of Galactic Heroes Die Neue These Encounters

275399.title: Into the Forest of Fireflies' Light
275399.seasonTitle: Into the Forest of Fireflies' Light

275405.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil
275405.evaluate: On the front lines of the war, there is a little girl. Blond hair, blue eyes, and porcelain white skin, she commands her squad with lisping voice. Her name is Tanya Degurechaff. But in reality, she is one of Japan's most elite salarymen, reborn as a little girl into a world of magical warfare after angering a mysterious being who calls himself God. Tanya resolves to ascend the ranks of her country's military as it slowly plunges into world war, with only Being X proving to be the strongest obstacle in recreating the peaceful life she once knew. But her perceptive actions and combat initiative have an unintended side effect: propelling the mighty Empire into becoming one of the most powerful nations in mankind's history.

275408.title: K-On!: Ura-On!
275408.evaluate: The seven Blu-ray disc volumes of K-ON! have an extra short anime "Ura-ON!"

275409.title: Tamako Love Story
275409.evaluate: As she edges toward the end of her high school life, the energetic but generally clueless third-year Tamako Kitashirakawa has only one major concern: pulling off a stunning baton performance at the Usagiyama Marching Festival. But all too soon, she is confronted by the reality that all her friends have big plans for their futures; she, on the other hand, just operates with the moderate goal of continuing to work at her family's restaurant. Under the same brilliant sky, Mochizou Ooji intends to study at a university in Tokyo, leaving behind his family, friends, and most importantly, his first and only love Tamako. Unfortunately, the shy admirer cannot bring himself to declare his love, and Tamako is yet unaware that she is the source of such anguish. With time quickly running out, Mochizou must confess his feelings to Tamako soon, or his dream of romance will never be fulfilled.

275424.title: Citrus
275424.evaluate: Yuzu, a high school gyaru who hasn't experienced her first love yet, transfers to an all-girls school after her mother remarries. She's beyond upset that she can't land a boyfriend at her new school. Then, on her first day, she meets the beautiful black-haired student council president Mei in the worst way possible. What's more, she later finds out that Mei is her new step-sister, and they'll be living under the same roof! And so the love affair between two polar opposite high school girls who find themselves drawn to one another begins!

275444.title: Yuri!!! on Ice
275444.evaluate:
Reeling from his crushing defeat at the Grand Prix Finale, Yuuri Katsuki, once Japan's most promising figure skater, returns to his family home to assess his options for the future. At age 23, Yuuri's window for success in skating is closing rapidly, and his love of pork cutlets and aptitude for gaining weight are not helping either.

However, Yuuri finds himself in the spotlight when a video of him performing a routine previously executed by five-time world champion, Victor Nikiforov, suddenly goes viral. In fact, Victor himself abruptly appears at Yuuri's house and offers to be his mentor. As one of his biggest fans, Yuuri eagerly accepts, kicking off his journey to make it back onto the world stage. But the competition is fierce, as the rising star from Russia, Yuri Plisetsky, is relentlessly determined to defeat Yuuri and win back Victor's tutelage.
episodeTitles: Easy as Pirozhki!! The Grand Prix Final of Tears
I Am Eros, and Eros Is Me?! Face-Off! Hot Springs on Ice

275446.title: Melancholy things
275446.evaluate: The task of returning the monsters who were supposed to be in the "hidden world" but ended up staying in the "present world" for various reasons is what is referred to as the "elimination of demons." By using accidentally found contact information, a high school student named Ashiya Hanae who was under the influence of a monster visited the store "Mononokean," where monsters are exorcised. There was Harusai Abe, the displeased shop owner. For some reason, Ashiya began serving the government. Here, the tale of the monsters and the demon union of Abe and Ashiya began.

275492.title: Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic
275492.evaluate: Suddenly, clusters of ancient dynastic ruins called "DUNGEON" appear one after another in the world. Legend has it that this contains magical items called "DJINN goldware" "and mountains of gold and silver treasures sleeping forever. In the desert city of Oasis, Alibaba, a young man working in Qishan, is one of those who dream of gaining a lot of money because of the "labyrinth". One day he meets up with Aladdin, a young man with incredible powers. The adventure of Aladdin and Alibaba now begins.

275496.title: Magic Sister
275496.evaluate:
"I met her..., and the cute but'weird' senior!" 
 likes conjure, but because of stage fright, the failure rate is 100%! ? 
 was forced to join the magic club by such a "senior sister", but was used as an "assistant"... 
 The busker sisters and brothers "A Saki" and "A Masa" and "Maa" from the chemistry department are involved. The senpai is also full of energy today, with a little bit of color and a big failure! 
 picture is too beautiful to watch but still want to watch the clumsy trick funny animation!

275503.title: Do you like the mother who can attack all the people and can attack twice?
275503.evaluate: Masato Oosuki is a teenager who is usually annoyed by his overly doting mother, Mamako, until both are teleported to a fantasy-themed world inside an online game.
275503.seasonTitle: Do you like the mother who can attack all the people and can attack twice?

275508.title: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪: Maji Love 2000%
275508.evaluate:
Entering her Master's course, Nanami Haruka is facing an even more difficult time. And she isn't the only one. The main six members of Starish are assigned new seniors to watch over them! But the seniors aren't having the best attitudes about it.

Watch Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Maji Love 2000% and find yourself completely engaged in a whole new adventure mixed in with comedy and romance!

275509.title: Magic Kaito
275509.evaluate: Kid, the strange thief known as "Heisei Lupin," no matter how tightly guarded the diamond jewelry is, it is easy for him. He has always been the nightmare of Zhongsen Yin's third-class police officer, but his identity has always been a mystery. A second-year high school student Kuroba Kuaito is a handsome boy from a family of magicians. He flirts with his childhood sweetheart Aoko Nakamori and enjoys it all day long, which causes a lot of trouble. By chance, he found a secret room behind the portrait of his father, Kuroba Teiichi. Not only did he discover various sophisticated equipment, but also discovered that his father, who died in an accident 8 years ago, was inextricably related to Kid... A few days later, Kidd, who had disappeared for many years, issued a notice that he would steal the jewel Moon Eye from the Tokyo City Art Museum. A new war between police and thieves begins...

275510.title: Magic Kaito 1412
275510.evaluate: "Magic Kaito 1412" is a TV anime series adapted from the manga "Magic Kaito" created by Japanese cartoonist Aoyama Gosho. It is the TMS version of "Magic" that was broadcast intermittently as a special chapter of "Detective Conan" After "Quick Fight" animation, an independent animation series broadcast.

275513.title: One Piece: Dead End
275513.evaluate: The crew of Luffy and his ship have arrived at Anabaru's harbour. An enormous monetary reward awaits the first person who reaches the finish line first in a competition organized by the local casino. The competition is an exciting opportunity for Nami, so she decides to participate. It turns out that there is a conspiracy behind the competition, which is helmed by Gasparde, an ex-military commander. It is his plan to lure all the pirates to the military base and send them all to their deaths there. This dead-end adventure requires Luffy and his friends to overcome numerous tests and tribulations along the way.

275515.title: One Piece: The Curse of the Sacred Sword
275515.evaluate: As part of his quest to find the world's most expensive sword, Luffy and his crew head to an island. The crew was soon split by attacking marines and beautiful maidens. As Zoro betrays the crew to help an old friend, Luffy and Usopp wander through a cave, and the rest help a village fight marines, they help the crew defend their village from the marines. The sacred pearls Zoro takes during his defeat of Sanji are the only defense against the evil sword that will plunge the world into darkness.
275515.seasonTitle: One Piece: The Curse of the Sacred Sword

275517.title: One Piece: Clockwork Island Adventure
275517.evaluate: Trump Kyoudai (Trump Siblings) who have established a base on Clockwork Island have stolen his ship, according to the Thief Brothers. The Going Merry's Captain, Monkey D. Luffy, works with his crew to recapture their ship on Clockwork Island - Usopp, Zoro, Sanji and Nami.

275519.title: One Piece: The Movie
275519.evaluate:
Woonan is the legendary Great Gold Pirate, earning the nickname after accumulating about 1/3 of the gold available in the world. Even after his disappearance, the tales of his gold being stashed away in a remote island continue to persist, a juicy target that other pirates lust for.
One of the pirates going to great lengths to attain the treasure is El Drago. He and his crew have hunted down Woonan's former crew members one by one, and along the way, they find the map that will take them to the hidden island.
The map is not all they come across; they also manage to come into contact with the straw hat pirates. After a short battle, Luffy and company are robbed and separated from one another. Now they must find a way to make it to the island before El Drago does and take the legendary treasure for themselves.

275520.title: One Piece: The Giant Mechanical Soldier of Karakuri Castle
275520.evaluate: The Straw Hats fished out a treasure chest from a sunken ship, but they found that it didn't contain any treasures like gold or silver, but an old woman. In order to let the Straw Hats take her home, but also afraid of being hurt by the pirates, the old woman promised them that if she can return home safely, she would give them the "Golden Crown" on their Mecha Island. However, after arriving on the island, the Straw Hats were attacked by the island owner, instead of fighting back, they chose to listen to their voices and help unlock the secret of the Golden Crown.
275520.seasonTitle: One Piece: The Giant Mechanical Soldier of Karakuri Castle

275521.title: One Piece: Stampede
275521.evaluate: The Pirates Festival is the largest exhibition of pirates ever put up by pirates. The host Buena Festa, also known as the Master of Festivities, extends an invitation to Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat Crew. When they arrive, they discover a location filled with opulent pavilions and a large number of pirates, including those from the Worst Generation. The atmosphere is intense.

275522.title: One Piece Luffy Special: Adventure on Palm Island
275522.evaluate:
A TV special work following "Episode of Nami" (broadcast in August 2012). It was a special project to commemorate the release of the 12th movie "ONE PIECE FILM Z" and was broadcast on the same day as the movie's release date. 
 Unlike the previous "Episode" series, where the story is based on the original story, it is composed mainly of a completely new story. In the story, the scenes with the Red-Haired Pirates and the Alvida gang in the first and second episodes of the original are remade in the form of recollections of Luffy and Coby. Coby and Helmepo have appeared in the New World edition prior to the original manga. 
 Shizuka Kudo was in charge of the costume design for the Straw Hat Pirates, and the costume was shown in the form of a fashion show at the opening scene. 
 the "Out x Deluxe" program that was broadcast the day before, program guests Domu Narita and Keiji Yamashita will appear as villagers, and the state of Ateleco was broadcast [2] [3]. In addition, Fuji TV announcer Midori Matsuo also appears as a guest in the role of a clerk. 
 On March 22, 2013, Blu-ray Disc and DVD were released.
275522.seasonTitle: One Piece Luffy Special: Adventure on Palm Island
episodeTitles: One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Adventure on Hand Island

275523.title: One Piece: Episode of Merry - The Tale of One More Friend
275523.evaluate: Starting with the duel between Luffy and Usopp, to the disappearance of Robin, and finally the crew saying goodbye to their ship in tears, the chapter of the first ship of the Straw Hat crew, the Golden Merry, was completely reset in the movie. When Luffy, Zoro, Nami and the rest of the crew set sail to find the legendary treasure One Piece, the Golden Merry is also seen as a member of the Straw Hat Pirates on their adventure together.
275523.seasonTitle: One Piece: Episode of Merry - The Tale of One More Friend

275524.title: One Piece: Strong World
275524.evaluate: Once hearing the news that several islands in East Blue are being destroyed, Monkey D. Luffy and his friends immediately go to investigate. On their way, however, an outlandish pirate ship appears out of the sky, which is under the control of the infamous pirate Shiki, namely, "the Golden Lion", the man who ate the Float-Float Fruit and was the first jailbreaker from Impel Down. Shiki has a desire to defeat the World Government while lacking a useful assistant, therefore, Shiki kidnaps Nami to be his own navigator and sends the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates to his floating islands as hostages, which made her in a dilemma. Separated in a land under Shiki's absolute control, Luffy and his crew must survive the mystifying terrain in order to bring back their navigator as well as friend.

275526.title: One Piece Sapo Special Chapter Three Brothers' Bonds, Miracle Reunion and Inherited Will
275526.evaluate: The film tells the story of Sabo as the protagonist. Sabo met Luffy and Ace when he was a child and became sworn brothers. He hated his noble family background, hated the noble education instilled by his parents, and advocated freedom. On the day when he prepared a small boat to set sail, unfortunately, he met a passing Celestial Dragons. The boat was sunk, and Sabo drowned in the sea. Fortunately, he was rescued by the revolutionary army leader, Monkey D. Dragon, and was trained by him. Later, Sabo served as the chief of staff of the Revolutionary Army, that is, the "Second Number One" of the Revolutionary Army. A few years passed, Sabo replaced Luffy in Dressrosa's arena and won the game, ate Ace's relic, and inherited the will of his brother.
275526.seasonTitle: One Piece Sapo Special Chapter Three Brothers' Bonds, Miracle Reunion and Inherited Will

275527.title: One Piece: Episode of Chopper Plus - Bloom in the Winter
275527.evaluate: The film is a reset of the Drum Island arc with new music and animations. Vivi has been removed from the main storyline, but Nico Robin and Franky, who boarded after the Drum Island storyline, have been added. In addition, the new ship of the Straw Hat Pirates, and the Thousand Sunny also appears in this work. According to author Oda, a new character will be created for the film, namely, Wapol's older brother, who also appears to be a Devil Fruit user...
275527.seasonTitle: One Piece: Episode of Chopper Plus - Bloom in the Winter

275529.title: One Piece: Chopper Kingdom of Strange Animal Island
275529.evaluate: The Straw Hat Pirates have come to Crown Island, where animals can speak the human language, and they want Chopper to be their new king. But there are also human hunters who have landed on the island, in search of the legendary horn that gives the wielders great power. In order to protect the island and protect the animals that live on the island, Luffy and his friends must stop the hunters from destroying the animal kingdom.
275529.seasonTitle: One Piece: Chopper Kingdom of Strange Animal Island

275530.title: One Piece 3D2Y crosses the death of Ace! Pledge with Luffy partners
275530.evaluate: The new story of this work is based on the timeline after the end of the Great War on the top of Malinfando. It tells the story of Luffy being photographed flying to Ruscana Island to learn domineering during the years of losing Ace forever and being separated from his companions. Characters like Silvers Rayleigh, Boa Hancock, Bucky, Perona, and more will also be featured. In addition, there will be a new enemy - Byrnndi World, who has the Devil Fruit.
275530.seasonTitle: One Piece 3D2Y crosses the death of Ace! Pledge with Luffy partners

275538.title: Chihayafuru
275538.evaluate:
Tomboyish girl Chihaya Ayase is contented with her share in life till she meets Arata Wataya, a quiet transfer student who introduces her to competitive karuta.

Along with the prodigy Arata and her haughty but hard-working friend Taichi Mashima, she joins the local Shiranami Society. The trio spends their idyllic childhood days playing together, until circumstances split them up.

275578.title: Made in Abyss
275578.evaluate: The “Abyss” is the last unexplored region, an enormous and treacherous cave system filled with ancient relics and strange creatures. Only the bravest of adventurers can traverse its depths, earning them the nickname, “Cave Raiders.” Within the depths of the Abyss, a girl named Riko stumbles upon a robot who looks like a young boy. Tantalized by the Abyss, Riko and her new friend descend into uncharted territory to unlock its mysteries, but what lies in wait for them in the darkness?
episodeTitles: The City of the Great Pit

275581.title: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons
275581.evaluate:
Revered as heroes for their role in defending Tristain, Louise Françoise and her familiar Saito Hiraga face heavy pressure to continue protecting the Kingdom. With an uneasy peace now established within Albion, the newly crowned Queen Henrietta must deal with a political struggle brewing on the horizon. To make matters worse, a new villain has begun plotting in the shadows against the Crown.

With the continuing threats that face the Kingdom, Louise and Saito are compelled to work together once more. No longer "Louise the Zero," the young mage's newfound aptitude for Void magic gives her enough power to wipe out an entire village; however, wielding these abilities comes with its share of challenges. As more conflicts arise, the idea of placing honor above oneself is put into question—regardless of their answer, their only choice is to see it through until the end.
275581.seasonTitle: The Familiar of Zero: Knight of the Twin Moons

275582.title: The Familiar of Zero: Rondo of the Princesses OVA
275582.evaluate: DVD beach episode of Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo. Also known as episode #6.5.
275582.seasonTitle: The Familiar of Zero: Rondo of the Princesses OVA

275583.title: The Familiar of Zero F
275583.evaluate:
Saito Hiraga and Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière go on the offensive after the events of Zero no Tsukaima: Princesses no Rondo. Together, they face off against King Joseph in the Holy City of Romalia with the help of two others who control the power of the “void”. But in the midst of the many conflicts ahead of them, an ancient evil begins to stir in the shadows.

Will their close bonds blossom into something more or will they be shattered through the ever increasing difficulty of the tasks that they must undertake? Zero no Tsukaima F follows the story of Louise and Saito as they face their final challenges together.

275584.title: Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers
275584.evaluate:
Legend says, when the Evil God awakens from the darkness, the god of fate will summon Six Braves and grant them with the power to save the world.

However, when Adlet Mayer arrives the destination to fight the Demon God, intending to meet up with their fellow heroes, seven heroes are present, and soon the others begin to suspect Adlet to be a fraud!

275676.title: Shakugan no Shana: The Movie
275676.evaluate:
Crimson Denizens and Rinne, beings from a parallel world, seek to devour humans' precious existences. To restore the delicate balance of the world, Flame Hazes hunt these entities down.

Yet such things are unknown to Yuuji Sakai, who starts his day like any other and heads to school. His day, however, takes a turn for the extraordinary when he witnesses everyone around him freeze in place and is left the only one able to move. Immediately, a Rinne begins devouring the souls of those around him, but as the creature sets its sights on Yuuji, a katana-wielding Flame Haze with blazing red hair saves him.

After his protector fixes the damage done, she explains why Yuuji was able to move: he has become a Torch, a remnant of a dead human being that will eventually fade from memory. Furthermore, he is also a Mystes, a Torch that houses an unknown treasure. Before his flame burns out completely, a Crimson Denizen will try to seize the treasure he holds, so the fiery hunter decides to watch over him. As Yuuji comes to terms with being dead, he resolves to live his life the best he can with the time he has remaining.

275677.title: Shakugan no Shana: Season II
275677.evaluate:
Denizens from the Crimson Realm continue to infiltrate Misaki City and steal life energy from humans. To combat this threat, Flame Hazes are tasked with saving humans from losing their existences. But while it is a Flame Haze's duty to protect humans, Shana—the "Flame-Haired Burning-Eyed Hunter"—seems to be focusing her attention on one human in particular: Yuuji Sakai, a teenage boy who was unwittingly dragged into the fight between Crimson Denizens and Flame Hazes. Since her first encounter with Yuuji, Shana has started to see him as more than just a friend. In fact, Yuuji wonders if Shana might have revealed her feelings to him once before, but it is difficult for him to confirm due to her hot-and-cold personality. Nonetheless, their days pass like any other, until a new transfer student arrives at their high school—one who bears a striking resemblance to an old enemy.
Yuuji and Shana have no time to dance around their feelings for each other; while their adversaries from the Bal Masqué organization plan their next attack, the two must keep their guard up as they explore the origin behind the coveted magical object within Yuuji's body, the "Midnight Lost Child."

275678.title: Shakugan no Shana: Season III
275678.evaluate: Yuji disappeared the fateful night he was supposed to choose between a life combating evil by Shana's side or as a normal teenager. He returns from near-death to lead the Crimson Denizens in a dubious plot to bring peace to the universe, but Shana isn't fooled. In an explosive reunion, the fiery warrior faces her unlikeliest of foes while Flame Hazes from across the world join forces to ignite a war that will determine the fate of all supernatural kind.

275679.title: Shakugan no Shana S: OVA Series

Finally, in a two-part special, Shana tracks a Denizen's trail by sorting through a Torch's memories for clues. Her sleuth skills reveal a teenage girl's heartwarming last days and a predator with a serious identity crisis!

But when she discovers that said home is a rundown shrine, she tries to leave; however, she is caught by two shrine spirits and a fox familiar named Tomoe. They mistake her for the man Nanami rescued—the land god of the shrine, Mikage. Realizing that Mikage must have sent her there as a replacement god, Tomoe leaves abruptly, refusing to serve a human.

Rather than going back to being homeless, Nanami immerses herself in her divine duties. But if she must keep things running smoothly, she will need the help of a certain hot-headed fox. In her fumbling attempt to seek out Tomoe, she lands in trouble and ends up sealing a contract with him. Now the two must traverse the path of godhood together as god and familiar; but it will not be easy, for new threats arise in the form of a youkai who wants to devour the girl, a snake that wants to marry her, and Nanami's own unexpected feelings for her new familiar.

"Senshadou" is a traditional sport using World War II era tanks in elimination-based matches. Widely practiced by women and girls alike, it's advertised as a form of art geared towards making ladies more prominent in culture and appealing to men. Becoming a worldwide phenomenon over time, the influence of senshadou leads to the creation of a world championship which will soon be held in Japan.

Miho Nishizumi, who comes from a lineage of well-respected senshadou specialists, is at odds with the sport after a traumatic event led to her retirement and eventually a rift to form between her and her family. To steer clear of the practice as much as possible, she transfers to Ooarai Girls High School where the senshadou program has been abolished. However, with the news of the upcoming championships, the school revives their tankery program, and Miho is pushed into joining.

Now, with the aid of some new friends, she must overcome her past and once again take command of a squadron of tanks in an effort to save her school from closure, all while proving to her family that the Nishizumi-style of senshadou is not solely about victory.

Shunned by his peers and nicknamed "Dorota-bou" after a yokai that lives in the mud, he helps Inugami uncover the truth behind the killings—but supernatural forces are at work, and while Dorota-bou is just a nickname, it might not be the only thing about the boy that isn't human.

Haijima, with his overwhelming passion and talent for volleyball, forms an ace combination with Kuroba.

Awaiting them are the 163 cm hot-blooded captain Shinichirou Oda, the talented and sharp-tongued vice-captain Misao Aoki and his third-year pair, and second-year students, including Akito Kanno, who is always wearing long sleeves due to his allergy to sunlight.

As the snow melts and spring arrives, Senkuu and his allies in Ishigami Village complete their preparations for an attack on the Tsukasa Empire. The Kingdom of Science is ready to launch its latest plan to recruit a sizable Tsukasa army to its side. It was a race against time; for every day the Science Kingdom spent perfecting their inventions, the Empire's numbers grew rapidly. With both sides pursuing their ideal world, the Stone War has now begun!

276444.title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)
276444.evaluate: The world of Hunter x Hunter is one in which risky jobs for Hunters include catching criminals and valiantly looking for forgotten treasures in unfamiliar areas. Gon Freecss, a 12-year-old Hunter who had been abandoned as a child, is dedicated to become the finest Hunter he can be in the hopes of one day reuniting with his father, a Hunter himself. Gon quickly learns, though, that the road to attaining his objectives is far more difficult than he could have ever anticipated.

276445.title: Theatre of Darkness 6
276445.evaluate:
Late at night, in a clearing within a dark fog-filled forest, there sits a kamishibai storyboard. A visitor approaches, and suddenly, the fog recedes. A shape begins to take form beside the board—this figure is the masked Storyteller, who once again starts to spin tales of horror and despair.

The events described in these macabre tales might happen to anyone, even your neighbors or friends: a group of girls bully one of their members in a cave, only to find themselves the victims of a dark presence; a boy with scopophobia moves to the countryside, but he still cannot escape the eyes of others; a man has a window that won't stay closed, and is the recipient of strange phone calls; and a salaryman steals an umbrella on a rainy day, but this seemingly insignificant act leads to consequences he never expected. Visitors may enjoy the Storyteller's offerings, but they should also be vigilant so that they don't wind up as the subjects of his next story.

276447.title: Theatre of Darkness 7
276447.evaluate:
A rusted door opens to a decrepit apartment filled with darkness. Inside, the masked Storyteller waits to spin more twisted tales of horror, inviting all to listen.
In one story, a woman is tormented by her past sins; in another, a man visits a chilling art exhibit, where things quickly go awry when he ignores the warnings regarding taking photographs. That is not all, though—an unsuspecting woman hears strange noises from her veranda, but when her boyfriend investigates, he receives the shock of his life; a lady receives a frantic call from her sister, who begs her to come to a phone booth, but when she arrives, she realizes that things are not as they appear; and a man looks for one of his belongings in his little sister's room, only to soon discover that a malevolent presence lives there. The Storyteller is all too eager to share these tales, which will no doubt shock and terrify his audience.

276455.title: Theatre of Darkness 3
