278572.seasonTitle: Classroom of the Elite III(Dub Indo)

278573.title: Chained Soldier(Thai Dub)
278573.evaluate: Yuuki Wakura observes the destruction of Earth by opposing supernatural forces. Mato serve as entry points to alternate dimensions and as routes for dangerous monsters to flee. Women are given peaches as resources, which endows them with abilities. Kyouka Uzen, the chief of the Anti-Demon Corp's Seventh Unity, shows in to save Yuuki from a monster. Unexpectedly, Yuuki has the ability to boost the Peaches' potency. However, Yuuki has to be prepared to serve Kyouka both at home and on the battlefield if she is to save the planet.

278575.title: Sasaki and Peeps(Thai Dub)
278575.evaluate: Sasaki, a regular company employee (a wage slave) who is nearly forty years old and relatively unnoticed, was persuaded by his colleagues who had pets and chose to maintain dogs. He acquired a Java sparrow Peeps after meeting it unexpectedly in a pet store. Peeps, on the other hand, is the reincarnation of a sage from another world with the unique capacity to speak with people. As a result, Sasaki and Peeps started a new story about traveling between the other worlds and the real world.

278576.title: Blue Exorcist -Shimane Illuminati Saga-(Thai Dub)
278576.evaluate:
The third season will focus on the enigmatic Illuminati society, who have ties to demons. The ultimate aim of this cheerful organization is to bring Satan back to life, but in the interim, they are experimenting on human zombies and creating an elixir that can bring demons back to life anywhere in the world. The strongest Demon is Lucifer, also known as the King of Light. Still, the abilities of a certain ExWire must be forced in order to create the ideal potion.
At the conclusion of Ao no Exorcist Season 2, Rin's brother Yukio defeated the demonic Illuminati agent, while their member, the treacherous Saburota Todou, departed in an ashed form due to his regenerative powers. It's possible that Yukio received his powers from his father, Satan, but he kept this information from Rin and the ExWires.

278582.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable (Thai Dub)
278582.evaluate: It's the year 1999, 11 years after Jotaro Kujo's desperate fight against Dio in Egypt. Jotaro meets with Josuke Higashikata, the illegitimate son of his grandfather Joseph Joestar. He discovers that Josuke also has the same "Stand" power and that a new threat is surfacing in Morioh City.
278582.seasonTitle: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable (Thai Dub)

278583.title: The Age Of Cosmos Exploration
278583.evaluate: As Earth faces an existential crisis triggered by the arrival of neutron-star debris, a special forces unit known as Black Star Squad, led by Yao Yuan, takes on the mission to secure humanity’s future. Aboard the starship Hope, they evacuate vast numbers of civilians from the planet and set out into the cosmos in search of a new home. Along the way, amid peril and battle, Yao Yuan and his comrades uncover the existence of a far‑higher‑order cosmic civilization—and come to grips with a chilling truth: the universe is no paradise, but a dark and treacherous unknown realm, teeming with death and dread.

278584.title: A Thousand Days of Tortured Love Letters (Thai)
278584.evaluate: Chairman Zhou dies in an unexpected accident, and his eldest daughter, Zhou Yue, is framed by the rising star Zhou Mengqi in a bid to seize the entire Zhou family fortune. Mo Jinye, the president of the Imperial Capital Group, announces an arranged marriage with Zhou Mengqi due to health concerns. Little does anyone know that Zhou Yue, who had been drugged by Zhou Mengqi and handed over to an older man, ends up sharing a one‑night stand with the drunken Mo Jinye. Seizing the opportunity, Zhou Yue blackmails him into helping her reclaim the Star‑Raising Group from Zhou Mengqi—only to be coldly rebuffed. From that moment on, their fates become inextricably entwined, setting off a tormented love–hate relationship filled with wit, courage, and relentless conflict.
278584.seasonTitle: A Thousand Days of Tortured Love Letters (Thai)

278590.title: A Thousand Days of Sadistic Love Letter
278590.evaluate:
This is the drama of two CEOs whose lives tangle up in a love-hate relationship.
After Zhou Yue’s father dies from an accident, popular movie star Zhou Mengqi plots to take over the Zhou family company, leaving nothing for Zhou Yue the eldest daughter and rightful CEO.
Mo Jinye, the CEO of Dijing Group, plans to marry Mengqi for personal health reason. But he ends up having a one night stand with Zhou Yue who was drugged by Zhou Mengqi. Yue and Mo form a forced alliance to take back Yue’s company. Their sadistic fights turn into love somehow.
278590.seasonTitle: A Thousand Days of Sadistic Love Letter

278591.title: Gods' Games We play
278591.evaluate:
Troubled by their excessive amount of free time, the gods finally grew bored. Thus, the challenging battles of wits between gods and humanity began. Only a few top players called “apostles” can meet the gods to beat them.

  Awakened after sleeping for thousands of years, a former god named Leshea desires to meet “this era’s very best player.” Fay, an acclaimed rookie apostle, is to whom she is introduced. Together, they plan to challenge the gods and win the ultimate prize, but this is a goal that no human in history has ever achieved before. The gods are cruel, witty, capricious, and even invincible. In the face of absurdity, how can the apostles obtain their seemingly impossible triumph?

278592.title: WIND BREAKER
278592.evaluate: Haruka Sakura is only interested in the most powerful of the strong; he has no desire to connect with weaklings. He recently enrolled in Furin High School, a filthy educational institution defined exclusively by physical prowess, which they use to deter evildoers from their town. But Haruka only wants to fight his way to the top; he doesn't care about being a hero or a member of any group!
episodeTitles: He Who Stands at the Peak

278593.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
278593.evaluate:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
278593.seasonTitle: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

278595.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2
278595.evaluate:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.

Now let's see what will happen in season 2!

278597.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc
278597.evaluate: Demon attacks have stopped ever since Nezuko Kamado's immunity to sunlight was made public. The Demon Slayer Corps is aware that a fresh and deadly conflict is imminent since Muzan Kibutsuji is preparing to kidnap her. All of Kagaya's members—including the Hashira—are subjected to rigorous training in the quiet before the storm, and Tanjiro uses the demanding curriculum to improve himself and gain some further knowledge about the group's most formidable Demon Slayers.
278597.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc
episodeTitles: In Order to Defeat Muzan Kibutsuji
The Sorrows of the Water Hashira, Giyu Tomioka
Tanjiro is Fully Recovered and Taking the Hashira Training

278600.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season3
278600.evaluate:
After Clayman is vanquished, Rimuru formally assumes the throne as the Demon King, extending his domain to encompass the entirety of the Great Jura Forest.
Anticipating a deluge of race representatives, Rimuru chose to make use of his attendance to consider using the "Foundation Festival" as a means of attracting new people to "Destiny City".
Distinguishing actual adversaries and allies and pursuing the concept of the "Sphere of Co-Prosperity between Humans and Demons," Rimuru's new adventure is about to begin. Rimuru made this decision after learning that Hinata was traveling to the Destiny City.
278600.seasonTitle: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season3

278601.title: Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers
278601.evaluate: Every year, hundreds of heroes from other planets are called to battle in the Magical Kingdom of Klyrode against the Dark One and his army of formidable demons. One of those heroes, Banaza is called upon from the Paluma Royal Capital, but something is wrong because Banaza is just a regular shopkeeper. In addition to lacking fighting prowess and magic, his stats are awful. Even worse, an accident prevents him from going home! Banaza's fate appears to be rather grim: he is despised as a hero and left trapped on a different planet, abandoned to the outer corners of the kingdom by a ruthless ruler who simply wants him dead. What will happen, though, when the failed hero candidate reaches level two and discovers he has super cheat powers?
278601.seasonTitle: Chillin’ in Another World with Level 2 Super Cheat Powers

278605.title: Re：Monster
278605.evaluate:
After an untimely demise, Tomokui Kanata was reincarnated as Goburou, the weakest goblin. But Goburou has undergone an odd transformation, kept the memory of his former life, and become powerful enough to use food to elevate his social standing.

Events in this other reality of survival of the fittest take place with capable allies and subordinates, a charming example of the tail-wagging dog...

278606.title: A Condition Called Love
278606.evaluate: Despite being loved by her family and friends, first-year high school student Hotaru Hinase is unsure of what love is. She happened to see the attractive boy Hananoi from the nearing class being turned away one day. With a nonchalant gesture, Hotaru handed over the umbrella to Hananoi, who was standing by himself in the park. This little mishap developed into a chance. With a public confession to Hotaru, Hananoi pleaded, "Please date me." What does "like" mean? Furthermore, what is "love"? Hotaru was taken aback by the abrupt revelation, but Hananoi declared, "I will do anything for the people I love." He was continuously expressing his affection. The preface to their first love starts here: a clingy boy whose love is inexplicable and a high school girl who doesn't understand love.

278607.title: Black Butler -Public School Arc-
278607.evaluate: Being the most esteemed public school in Britain, Weston College is so exclusive that it won't even accept help from the government. So, when several of the pupils at the school—including Derrick Arden, the cousin of Queen Victoria's son—refuse to return home and stop communicating with their families, Ciel Phantomhive is forced to enroll in Weston College in order to look into the matter. As Sapphire Owl's new housemaster, Sebastian Michaelis has joined the team.

278609.title: THE NEW GATE
278609.evaluate: Tens of thousands of people play the life-or-death game "The New Gate" online. The most accomplished veteran player, Shin, is the reason the other players will eventually be let go from the game. After taking down the final boss, Shin feels like he can finally make it out until a strange burst of light blinds him. When he wakes up, 500 years have passed and he is back in the game's world! Thus starts a new chapter in the life of the greatest player of all time!

278615.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
278615.evaluate: Yumiko Satō and Chika Watanabe are new idol voice actresses who have been in the voice acting business for a while and were classmates in the same high school. Their managers later scheduled a radio program for the two who don't know each other to discuss their school days. They have to maintain their friendship within the program even though they fight frequently outside of it.
278615.seasonTitle: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
episodeTitles: Yuhi and Yasumi Can't Hide Anymore?
Yuhi and Yasumi and Overnight Stay

278617.title: Immortality 3
278617.evaluate: How can the hero Fang Han use his own strength to traverse the vast fantastical world? By clinging to an unwavering refusal to accept defeat, he cracked the code of supernatural abilities and transformed his mortal body into an immortal one. Fang Han will reveal a new and prosperous world filled with immortals, demons, and mortals, along with countless innovative magic weapons. In addition, Fang Han will encounter conflicts between immortals and demons, love and hate. It will eventually lead to success.

278627.title: Mom, I'm Sorry
278627.evaluate: When Cuican Dong eventually found out that his mother had a fatal illness, everything in his world collapsed. They had each other and nothing else in the world, after all. It was too late to make up for the fact that he had always taken his mother's affection for granted. Was it, or was it not? On his mother's bedside, an enigmatic guy approached him and offered to give his mother a new life at the expense of his own life expectancy. The 50-year-old Jinyu Yan was granted a second chance at life when the desperate Cuican struck the arrangement. The drawback? Now, she was younger than her own son!

278628.title: The Charm of Soul Pets
278628.evaluate: The main character, Chu Mu, was the heir to the Chu Clan, but he was banished to the island and faced an almost certain death as a result of a planned assassination. He danced on the brink of death, fighting for his life with a little Moonlight Fox he had captured. He had to exhale when he was finally free of the demonic foremen on his island. However, he was unaware that this was just the start of his destined trip with his tiny Moonlight Fox.

278630.title: DON'T GIVE UP
278630.evaluate: A numb and bored office worker named Men Ke unintentionally found himself in the predicament of "being bored to death" and began attempting to save himself with the assistance of the alien Yasen.

278631.title: Villain Initialization
278631.evaluate: After 35 years as a villain, Ling Chen "initialized" his reset-rebirth to 17 years old during his final conflict with Ye Muxue! What? Do you believe he longs to revert to humanity? Speak less! Naturally, since Ye Mu wasn't superpowered at the moment, it was time to murder him!

278632.title: Back to the Great Ming
278632.evaluate: Zheng Shaopeng, a high school student, dozed off during a history lesson. When he awoke, he discovered that he had changed into the impoverished scholar Yang Lin and had traveled to the Danzhu Dynasty in the history textbook. Initially, Yang Lin struggled to adjust to life in the past, but when he applied contemporary ideas to create a few modest innovations, he won the villagers' affection and eventually discovered a feeling of identity of his own. Yang Lin lived through a time of both internal and exterior unrest, experiencing battles and seeing the agony of the populace. By relying on his knowledge and abilities to acquire access to the court, he eventually oversaw the Danzhu Dynasty's efforts to combat internal corruption and repel formidable adversaries.

278634.title: Fabulous Beasts 3
278634.evaluate: Pipi, a legendary beast from ancient mythology, made his way to human civilization. He ran away to the deer shop that his friend Si Buxiang, who specialized in aiding mythological beasts, opened to avoid being persecuted by humans. In addition, he got to know a collection of mythological creatures with various personalities from all over the world, and he started leading a laid-back lifestyle far from people. And now let's see what will happen in season 3!

278635.title: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered (Thai Dub)
278635.evaluate:
The Sage who brought Yogiri Takatou's school bus to another planet demonstrates to the children how terrible both the world and she are by murdering the adults for trivial reasons and instructing them to become sages in order to battle demons. She leaves the others to perish, taking only the skilled.
Yogiri seeks to return with his classmate Tomochika Dannora, but Tomochika becomes uneasy due to Yogiri's indifference to the strangeness. Yogiri is actually not your typical child; he has the ability to willfully kill everything.
278635.seasonTitle: My Instant Death Ability is Overpowered (Thai Dub)

278636.title: Ron Kamonohashi's Forbidden Deductions 2nd Season
278636.evaluate: Ron Kamonohashi, once hailed as a genius at the world-renowned Detective Training Academy Blue, had his qualification to become a detective revoked due to a fatal “flaw”. After enduring a period of unappreciated talent, his destiny was greatly altered by his encounter with Totomaru Isshiki from the Metropolitan Police Department's First Investigative Division, who is nicknamed “Toto”. Ron takes on the role of solving mysteries, while Toto is in charge of investigation. Together, they consecutively crack difficult cases and gradually become a famous partnership.
episodeTitles: Shibuya Revelation Serial Murders Case, Part 1
Shibuya Revelation Serial Murders Case, Part 2
Shibuya Revelation Serial Murders Case, Final

278637.title: A SALAD BOWL OF ECCENTRICS
278637.evaluate: A destitute detective named Sousuke Kaburaya encounters Sara, a princess with magical abilities from another world. One day they move in together, and Sara swiftly adapts to modern Japanese living. Livia, the female knight who teleported with Sara, was unexpectedly joyful despite living in homelessness. The optimistic and resilient attitude of these two extraterrestrials not only influences Sousuke but also a host of peculiar personalities that reside here, including ruthless attorneys, love-breakers, and pious scholars...

278638.title: An Archdemon`s Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
278638.evaluate:
Zagan is referred to be the evil magician. He may not speak well and have a fierce demeanor, but he practices magic seriously every day and chases out robbers from his territory.
Later, Zagan encountered the white-haired elf maiden Nephy, who was up for auction as a Demon King relic, fatefully when his friend Barbaros accompanied him to an illicit auction one day.
Zagan used all of his belongings to entice Nephy to return to his castle. But he was not adept with words and had never really interacted with people, so he didn't know how to talk to Nephy or even carry on a regular conversation.
278638.seasonTitle: An Archdemon`s Dilemma: How to Love Your Elf Bride
episodeTitles: First Love Is a Nasty Disease That Everybody Suffers
The First Love of Someone With a Communication Disorder Tastes Like Moldy Bread
It’s Terrifying When a Normally Quiet Child Gets Angry

278640.title: Grandpa and Grandma Turn Young Again
278640.evaluate:
They have been blissfully married for as long as they can remember, Shouzou and Ine Saitou. Their priceless bond shows how strong their love is even in their advanced years, when their limbs are crumbling and their faces are wrinkled. Then, one day, out of the blue, they awaken to discover they had returned to youth!

Even with their newfound youth and beauty, Shouzou and Ine are still the same. The elderly couple is followed by Jiisan Baasan Wakagaeru as they go about their everyday activities, spend time with family, and defy the expectations of the younger generation.
278640.seasonTitle: Grandpa and Grandma Turn Young Again
episodeTitles: Grandpa and Grandma and Sports Festival

278641.title: Tonbo!
278641.evaluate:
The main character, Ooi Tonbo, was raised by her grandfather, Gonji Ooi, a fisherman on the island of Kagoshima in the Tokara Islands, after she lost both of her parents in a car accident when she was a little child. The three golf courses on the island were designed by the locals, and Tonbo learns the game while utilizing her father's No. 3 iron.

Tonbo first encounters Kazuyoshi Igarashi, a former professional golfer who has traveled to Kagoshima in quest of employment, at the start of the story.

278643.title: Date A Live V
278643.evaluate: At least 150 million people lost their lives in the devastating "spacequake" that struck the core of Eurasia thirty years ago. Smaller earthquakes have been sporadically plaguing the Earth ever since. At the epicenter of a seismic event, Shido Itsuka, a seemingly normal high school student, discovers from his sister Kotori that the enigmatic girl he encountered is one of the "Spirits," who, when they materialize in the world, are the true source of seismic activity. Additionally, he finds out that Kotori is the commander of the airship Fraxinus, which is manned by the Ratatoskr organization. Kotori is hired to use his unexplained ability to seal the Spirits' abilities, preventing them from posing a threat to humanity. However, he has to make her fall in love with him and kiss him in order to seal a Spirit's power.

278644.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! S3
278644.evaluate: Kazuma is over it, so even though the abnormal party has returned, they might soon be without a member. His desire to become a monk is thwarted by Aqua, Megumin, and Darkness, who reject his lack of adventure. But the conflict over careers is put on hold when a princess asks to hear all of their stories. Will this be their farewell tour or will the taste of fame at the royal castle keep them together?
278644.seasonTitle: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! S3
episodeTitles: God's Blessing On a Bright Future
A Smile for the Unsmiling Girl

278646.title: The Irregular at Magic High School 3
278646.evaluate: After the Offshore Tower incident, a new year begins at Magic High School. Tatsuya, who transferred to the Magic Engineering course, started his second year, planning to lead a peaceful life with his younger sister Miyuki. However, despite the familial love between the brother and the sister, new dangers are approaching clandestinely. In the face of the villains' dire and dangerous schemes, can Tatsuya overcome the difficulties and protect his cherished sister?
278646.seasonTitle: The Irregular at Magic High School 3

278647.title: My Hero Academia 7th Season
278647.evaluate: Deku, students in the United States of America, professional heroes, are resolved to fight together rather than alone after an all-out war and a solitary battle with the enemy "Villains," and a massive evil spirit that is aiming for Deku's "Quirks," One For All, who is facing them. But the hope for victory in the last conflict between Shigaraki and the other villains was destroyed...
episodeTitles: In the Nick of Time, A Big-Time Maverick From the West

278653.title: Kaiju No. 8
278653.evaluate: Japan has one of the greatest rates of kaiju emergence worldwide, meaning that fatal monster attacks are common there. Here comes the Japan Defense Force, a military force assigned to destroy kaiju. Kaiju-corp cleanup man Kafka Hibino has always wanted to join the force. But he has an unforeseen metamorphosis when given another chance to fulfill his childhood ambition. Now that he has turned into a kaiju himself, how can he battle them?
episodeTitles: The Man Who Became a Kaiju

278655.title: Studio Apartment, Good Lighting, Angel Included
278655.evaluate: High school student Tarou Tokumitsu, who lives alone, meets Towa, a nice and innocent girl, on his balcony. However, who exactly is she...? As Miss Beelzebub Likes author Matoba gives you the newest adorable and innocent romantic comedy!
278655.seasonTitle: Studio Apartment, Good Lighting, Angel Included
episodeTitles: Can I Make Lunch for You?

278656.title: Yao-Chinese Folktales
278656.evaluate: The animated short‑film anthology “Chinese Tales” comprises eight self‑contained stories rooted in traditional Chinese culture: “The Summer of the Little Demon,” “Goose, Goose, Goose,” “Linlin,” “The Village Bus Carried Away Wang Hair and the Immortal,” “Xiaoman,” “Jade Rabbit,” “The Corner Store,” and “Birds and Fish.” Spanning ancient times to the present and looking toward the future, these tales range from rural nostalgia to technological fantasy, from existential themes to reflections on human nature, showcasing a distinctly Chinese imagination while embodying China’s cultural heritage and philosophy.

278657.title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World
278657.evaluate: When a Japanese salaryman passes away and reincarnates as Ars Louvent, the heir of an aristocratic family, he learns that he is also capable of evaluating the abilities and talents of others. In order to prepare for the impending battle for the throne's succession, Ars uses his unique abilities to find and persuade strong people who excel in a variety of fields, from magic and swordplay to strategy and diplomacy, to join his allies and servants.
278657.seasonTitle: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World

278660.title: Welcome Home
278660.evaluate: Masaki Fujiyoshi is a parent and spouse who stays at home. As an omega, which is a secondary gender that permits one to give birth regardless of gender, he has battled for a very long time with sentiments of burdening his devoted husband, Hiromu, because of the challenges they had in achieving domesticity. The family relocated to a more child-friendly region after the birth of their son, Hikari.

278661.title: My Hero Academia Memories
278661.evaluate: Deku, students in the United States of America, professional heroes, are resolved to fight together rather than alone after an all-out war and a solitary battle with the enemy "Villains," and a massive evil spirit that is aiming for Deku's "Quirks," One For All, who is facing them. But the hope for victory in the last conflict between Shigaraki and the other villains was destroyed...

278662.title: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time l Summarize Season l
278662.evaluate: Lonely thirty-seven-year-old Mikami Satoru is stuck in a dead-end job, unhappy with his mundane life, but after dying at the hands of a robber, he awakens to a fresh start in a fantasy realm...as a slime monster! As he acclimates to his goopy new existence, his exploits with the other monsters set off a chain of events that will change his new world forever!
278662.seasonTitle: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time l Summarize Season l
episodeTitles: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time I Summarize Season I

278663.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S4 (Thai Dub)
278663.evaluate: The monks used all available resources to pursue the three thousand ways of heaven throughout the era of popular scientific culture in order to catch a glimpse of the reality of heaven. The modern sword master Yi Jianchuan and his younger brother, the wicked sword god Chen Nanxuan, went in a completely different direction to seek the ultimate swordsmanship, one of the three thousand heavenly ways. Wang Ling is concerned with which heavenly road to follow today in order to have a serene daily existence, while the rest of the world is concerned with how to nurture a heavenly path.
278663.seasonTitle: The Daily Life of the Immortal King S4 (Thai Dub)

278664.title: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time I Summarize Season 2
278664.evaluate: With the help of Queen Ramiris, the children are now in stable condition and should lead normal lives, much to Rimuru’s relief. But all is not well… In fact, there are forces of humankind in this fantasy world that do not look kindly upon a slime-led nation of monsters. And now, insidious threats to Rimuru and the country of Tempest may be lurking around every corner!
278664.seasonTitle: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time I Summarize Season 2
episodeTitles: Learn about TenSura in an Hour: That Time I Summarize Season II

278665.title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?! (Thai Dub)
278665.evaluate: At thirty, Ando is still a virgin—and thanks to that, he’s been granted the rather unremarkable magic of reading the thoughts of anyone he touches. One day, he happens to eavesdrop on the mind of his handsome coworker, Kurosawa. To his surprise, Kurosawa has long harbored deep affection for him—what?! Thanks to this strange magic, the cool‑headed heartthrob’s love for the awkward virgin seems ready to spill out. A 200% pure love story begins!
278665.seasonTitle: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?! (Thai Dub)

278666.title: 2.5 Dimensional Seduction
278666.evaluate: "I have no interest in real girls!" As usual, Okumura, the Manga Study Club manager, is by himself in the club room, calling out the name of his favorite 2D character, Liliel, who is reflected on the screen. Amano Ririsa, a real girl who declares, "I want to be Liliel," is the person who comes to Okumura. She has been fascinated with the sexy and adorable "costumes" of manga girls. She is an otaku companion who has the same level of affection for Liliel as Okumura! Ririsa shows Okumura her hidden interest in cosplay and presents him with a collection of "ROM" that includes images and videos of cosplay. "I...I want to create something similar to this!" Then, just the two of them start the cosplay activities in the club room! Okumura is even astounded by how authentic Liliel appears on Ririsa! With a burst of enthusiasm, Okumura snatches a camera!? With their genuine and passionate feeling towards cosplay, a youth story about cosplay that “tells the love for something crazily” for all otakus begins now!!
episodeTitles: The New Member in Different Dimension

278667.title: Kurayukaba & Kuramerukagari
278667.evaluate:
This town's purple mist is a faint dream, which consists of enigmatic rumors.
And now, detective Soutaro takes on the enigmatic "mass disappearance" that has everyone perplexed!
It was unclear what the aim was, and there were no witnesses...
What's the real story behind the "creepy ruts" that constantly seem to follow them?
The detective enters the city's underground "Kuragari" area covertly in search of clues.
Then there is a sudden encounter between the commander of the Black Iron's armored train and it.
And this had a significant impact on the detective's fate!

278668.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind (Thai Dub)
278668.evaluate: Fresh from surviving his adventures in Morioh, Stand user and Joestar ally Koichi Hirose is touching down in Naples, Italy to discover a man known as Haruno Shiobana, who may well be the inheritor of a truly terrifying legacy. Though he now calls himself Giorno Giovanna and makes a living from petty thievery, there is no mistaking the regal bearing and cunning that mark his bloodline, or the natural Stand affinity that he's already begun to harness. Whatever he may call himself, Giorno Giovanna's parentage mark him as a true threat - for he is the son of Dio Brando, and no son of Dio could possibly live quietly on this earth.
278668.seasonTitle: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind (Thai Dub)

278669.title: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability (Thai Dub)
278669.evaluate:
Despite having a great love for magic, an exceptional sorcerer met an untimely end since he lacked both noble lineage and talent.
He was reborn as Lloyd, the seventh prince of the Kingdom of Salum with a strong magic heritage, after having thoughts of "wanting to delve deeper into magic" on his deathbed.
He not only had the memories of his past existence, but he was gifted and had the ideal lineage. Keeping in mind the unmet dreams from his past life, he was able to live an unmatched life of "exploring magic at will" because of his incredible magical abilities!
278669.seasonTitle: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability (Thai Dub)

278670.title: Re：Monster (Thai Dub)
278670.evaluate:
After an untimely demise, Tomokui Kanata was reincarnated as Goburou, the weakest goblin. But Goburou has undergone an odd transformation, kept the memory of his former life, and become powerful enough to use food to elevate his social standing.

Events in this other reality of survival of the fittest take place with capable allies and subordinates, a charming example of the tail-wagging dog...

278671.title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 (Thai Dub)
278671.evaluate:
Killed while saving a stranger from a traffic collision, a 34-year-old NEET is reincarnated into a world of magic as Rudeus Greyrat, a newborn baby. With knowledge, experience, and regrets from his previous life retained, Rudeus vows to lead a fulfilling life and not repeat his past mistakes.

Now gifted with a tremendous amount of magical power as well as the mind of a grown adult, Rudeus is seen as a genius in the making by his new parents. Soon, he finds himself studying under powerful warriors, such as his swordsman father and a mage named Roxy Migurdia—all in order to hone his apparent talents. But despite his innocent exterior, Rudeus is still a perverted otaku, who uses his wealth of knowledge to make moves on women whom he could never make in his previous life.

Now let's see what will happen in season 2!
278671.seasonTitle: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 2 (Thai Dub)

278681.title: ATRI -My Dear Moments-
278681.evaluate:
An unexplained sea level rise in the near future has submerged most of human civilization. After experiencing a difficult life in a large city, Ikaruga Natsuki, a young man who lost one of his legs in an accident a few years prior, returns home only to discover his former rural home partially submerged under the ocean. With no family left, all he has left is the ship and submarine his oceanologist grandmother gave him, along with her debts.

He sets out to explore the underwater remnants of his grandmother's laboratory in an attempt to retrieve his "lost future" and the rumored treasure she hid there. However, what he discovers is Atri, a strange girl, dozing off at the bottom of the ocean in what appears to be a coffin. Although she is a robot, anyone seeing her would mistake her for a real person because of the vividness of her appearance and emotions.

She declares to Natsuki that she wants to carry out her master's last directive as an expression of gratitude for being saved. Until she fulfills it, she'll be Natsuki's leg. An incredible summer is about to begin for this boy and this enigmatic robot girl in a small town that is gradually being engulfed by the sea.
episodeTitles: To the Cradle of the Sea

278686.title: THE NEW GATE (Thai Dub)
278686.evaluate: Tens of thousands of people play the life-or-death game "The New Gate" online. The most accomplished veteran player, Shin, is the reason the other players will eventually be let go from the game. After taking down the final boss, Shin feels like he can finally make it out until a strange burst of light blinds him. When he wakes up, 500 years have passed and he is back in the game's world! Thus starts a new chapter in the life of the greatest player of all time!

278687.title: THE NEW GATE (Dub Indo)

278693.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season3 (Thai Dub)
278693.evaluate:
After Clayman is vanquished, Rimuru formally assumes the throne as the Demon King, extending his domain to encompass the entirety of the Great Jura Forest.
Anticipating a deluge of race representatives, Rimuru chose to make use of his attendance to consider using the "Foundation Festival" as a means of attracting new people to "Destiny City".
Distinguishing actual adversaries and allies and pursuing the concept of the "Sphere of Co-Prosperity between Humans and Demons," Rimuru's new adventure is about to begin. Rimuru made this decision after learning that Hinata was traveling to the Destiny City.
278693.seasonTitle: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season3 (Thai Dub)

278694.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season3 (Dub Indo)
278694.evaluate:
After Clayman is vanquished, Rimuru formally assumes the throne as the Demon King, extending his domain to encompass the entirety of the Great Jura Forest.
Anticipating a deluge of race representatives, Rimuru chose to make use of his attendance to consider using the "Foundation Festival" as a means of attracting new people to "Destiny City".

278696.title: PSEUDO HAREM
278696.evaluate:
A harem with only one heroine?!
Eiji Kitahama, the drama club senior, who aspires to have a harem like in the manga series, and Rin Nanakura, who cannot help but act as other characters in front of her senior Kitahama.
Tsundere and Teaser, Clingy and Cool, as well as Ladylike, the more characters she plays, the more emotion she loses control of for her senior.
Is it possible that Nanakura expresses her true self to her senior, who is somewhat silly and thick-headed?
episodeTitles: The Beginning of a Grand Story?

278697.title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World Season 2
278697.evaluate: A great war has raged for years between the scientifically advanced Empire and Nebulis, the realm of the witches―until the youngest knight ever to receive the title of the Empire's strongest meets the princess of the rival nation. Though they are sworn enemies, the knight is taken by her beauty and dignity, and the princess is moved by his strength and way of life. Will the fighting between them ever be allowed to end? Just look forward to Season 2!
278697.seasonTitle: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World Season 2

278698.title: MASHLE MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc
278698.evaluate:
It is now public knowledge that Mash Burnedead possesses powers following his battle with Magia Lupus. After Mash is called before a group of Divine Visionaries by the Bureau of Magic, the brief celebration comes to an end when they decide that Mash will die as a result of their actions. But a sinister shadow group known as Innocent Zero seizes control of the investigation and demands that Mash be living.

Even after Mash demonstrates his ability to handle Innocent Zero, the Divine Visionaries' conclusion is upheld. Fortunately, Mash meets two unlikely allies in Headmaster Wahlberg Baigan and Divine Visionary Rayne Ames, who work together to postpone Mash's execution until Innocent Zero is vanquished. Mash's current permit to live is contingent upon his being chosen by the end of the year to be the Divine Visionary nominee.
278698.seasonTitle: MASHLE MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc
episodeTitles: Mash Burnedead and the Divine Visionaries
Mash Burnedead and the Home Visit

278699.title: Whimsical Wish
278699.evaluate: A cat accidentally brought college graduate Wei Ran into a world he had no idea existed. He discovered that the only train that could return him to the human world only runs once every six months while he was trying to find a way to get home. All he could do was move in with YaYa, the cat who owned Whimsical Wish, temporarily. Wei Ran unexpectedly discovered that the dragon scales would always appear wherever he went, just when things seemed to be stabilizing. And each time the dragon scale materialized, it had an entirely unique, bizarre effect.

278700.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc (Thai Dub)
278700.evaluate: Demon attacks have stopped ever since Nezuko Kamado's immunity to sunlight was made public. The Demon Slayer Corps is aware that a fresh and deadly conflict is imminent since Muzan Kibutsuji is preparing to kidnap her. All of Kagaya's members—including the Hashira—are subjected to rigorous training in the quiet before the storm, and Tanjiro uses the demanding curriculum to improve himself and gain some further knowledge about the group's most formidable Demon Slayers.
278700.seasonTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc (Thai Dub)

278701.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Hashira Training Arc (Dub Indo)

278703.title: LINK CLICK
278703.evaluate: In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their super powers to enter the photos in order to fulfill the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...

278704.title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
278704.evaluate: This is an adventure story about a determined young man named Will Serfort. He makes up his mind to fulfill a childhood promise to his friend by becoming a Magia Vander, who sit at the top of the Tower of Wizards. However, Will has still struggled to perform even the most basic spells. To compensate, he delves into dungeon battles to earn credits at the prestigious Regarden Magic Academy. Despite his magical shortcomings, Will possesses extraordinary swordsmanship skills, which is a legacy from his enigmatic past. Amidst the competitive Magic Academy, Will must confront perilous trials and rivalries while endeavoring to unlock his magical abilities.

278705.title: Suicide Squad Isekai
278705.evaluate: Amanda Waller, the leader of A.R.G.U.S., gathers a gang of infamous criminals in the crime-ridden city of Gotham, including Clayface, Deadshot, Deadshot, Harley Quinn, and King Shark, for a mission into an otherworldly realm that is connected to this world through a gate. Here, orcs rampage and dragons rule the skies in a world of swords and magic known as "ISEKAI." Following their arrival in ISEKAI, Harley and her friends are taken prisoner by the soldiers of the Kingdom and imprisoned while wearing bombs around their necks. Is Harley Quinn's group able to overcome this dangerous realm?

278707.title: A Nobody's Way Up to an Exploration Hero
278707.evaluate: Kaito Takagi was originally a high school student with a low status! By day, he explored the mystical dungeons around Japan, hunting slimes to make ends meet. One day, Kaito's world took a remarkable turn when he triumphed over a rare golden slime. In its aftermath, he discovers a priceless treasure, a mysterious card capable of summoning mythical beings! A warrior maiden with unparalleled beauty appears after he uses the card. Then a series of marvelous adventures begins……
278707.seasonTitle: A Nobody's Way Up to an Exploration Hero
episodeTitles: That Mob Aims to Be a Hero
Viscountess Rank Demon and Sylphy’s Problem

278708.title: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army was a Human
278708.evaluate: Right now, the humans are engaged in a fierce battle with the Demon Lord Army, among which the most striking member is the commanding magician of the Immortal Brigade, Ike. Although celebrated as the trusted aide of the Demon Lord Army, Ike hides a secret from surrounding demons, that is, he is actually a human, a mere mortal reincarnated from Japan!
278708.seasonTitle: The Strongest Magician in the Demon Lord's Army was a Human
episodeTitles: Ike, the Leader of the Immortal Brigade
Captain of the White Rose Knights, Alistair

278709.title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
278709.evaluate:
Masachika Kuze is seated next to Alya-san, who consistently gives him the cold shoulder.
Though occasionally she will speak to him in Russian and blurt out a few flirtatious phrases.
No word of it escapes Masachika's notice. That is because Masachika can listen to Russian at a native level!

Alya-san occasionally blurts out sweet words while acting as though he does not understand.
Masachika acts as though he does not understand the meaning.

Where will their tale of love—which makes you smile—take them?
278709.seasonTitle: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
episodeTitles: Alya Hides Her Feelings in Russian

278710.title: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells
278710.evaluate: High school student Touga Mimori, who is invisible in class, and his peers are unexpectedly called by a goddess to take on heroic roles in a fantastical world. Although the majority of them demonstrate remarkable abilities with S-rank, A-rank, and so forth, Mimori only possesses an E-rank, the lowest rank. Mimori is banished to a dungeon where there is almost no chance of survival because the goddess believes he is useless. But as it happens, his abilities are more unusual than they first appear to be. Then, this insignificant adolescent decides to take revenge on the goddess with giving up his nature.
278710.seasonTitle: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells

278711.title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
278711.evaluate:
The newest and strongest old man wants to be an adventurer!
"It is better to follow your dreams while you are still young."
That is the general consensus. However, some adults never give up.

In a world where teens are expected to become adventurers,
Rick Gladiator, a thirty-year-old guild clerk, dreamed of being an adventurer.
He has been training with the members of "Orihalcon Fist," a legendary group that assembles the toughest adventurers on the continent, for the past few days in an unimaginable world.
however, he possesses the fighting prowess of an S-rank, the highest rank, despite being a rookie F-rank!?
278711.seasonTitle: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
episodeTitles: Super First-Class Elite vs. F Rank Old Man

278712.title: I PARRY EVERYTHING
278712.evaluate:
A young child named Noor is unjustly judged as having no talent at all. He wants to be an adventurer and see the world, battle monsters, and save people. However, he understands that if he lacks talent, all he needs to do is work harder than anybody else, and as a result, he has mastered [Parry], the most basic skill that deflects attacks, and after more than ten years of practice, he eventually becomes extremely proficient.

Though Noor has managed to obtain the strongest power in the world, his skill level is still insufficient to qualify him as an adventurer, but he does not know that because he works odd jobs in the city during the day. Then, one day, when he unintentionally saves Princess Lynne from a monster's attack, Noor's destiny starts to move in an unexpected way!

278713.title: Bye Bye, Earth
278713.evaluate: Belle Lablac was the sole human born into a world where animals had human traits. She was nicknamed "Faceless," and because she lacked scales, fur, or fangs, she endured a lonely existence and could not relate to anybody else. "I'd like to integrate with the world...." She resolves to travel to find her roots with the Runding, a magnificent sword that is as tall as she is, and a tremendous deal of longing in her heart. She has no idea how many challenges are ahead for her...
episodeTitles: Embarking. At the Break of Dawn
Separation. Those Who Play on the Earth

278714.title: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring
278714.evaluate:
Because of a mistake that God made, Takumi Kayano lost his life and was reincarnated.
After being endowed with a variety of abilities, he was transported to a different planet and dropped into a perilous forest rife with monsters.
Takumi finds a young child and girl in the forest who look to be twins. He names them Alan and Elena and takes them under his protection. Astonished by the ease with which the two vanquish monsters with their martial arts prowess, Takumi arrives in town and joins the adventurer's guild in order to support himself.
He thus takes care of Alan and Elena as they grow up and begin a carefree life filled with adventures!
278714.seasonTitle: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring

278715.title: Twilight Out of Focus
278715.evaluate:
Mao has made the decision to film the lone wolf and troublemaker Hisashi at the film club.
The two eventually become sweetly bonded through the "promise" they make when living together in the dorm.
Junior Giichi is envious of Jin, the president of the popular film club.
Even though they do not get along, the two wind up falling in love.
Shion is a new member of the club who joins out of season, and Rei is the reserved, unsociable, but trustworthy vice president.
With an unplanned kiss, the two start their "relationship."

Via the lens, they all come to understand love!

278716.title: FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST
278716.evaluate: After a year of triumphing over the evil forces of Zeref and Acnologia, the Fairy Tail guild sets out to explore the northern continent of Guiltina. There, Natsu Dragneel accompanied by Lucy Heartfilia, Gray Fullbuster, Erza Scarlet, Wendy Marvell, as well as the exceeds Happy and Charlés, they find the employer of the 100 Years Quest and are given an almost unfathomable task: to lock up the Five Dragon Gods, a group of people with such immense power that, if left unchecked, could wipe out the entire human race. As this is going on, Fairy Tail recruits Touka, a passionate new member. There appears to be more to her than meets the eye, despite the fact that her intense passion and lively energy make her ideal for the guild.

278717.title: Plus-Sized Elf
278717.evaluate: Just before he leaves for the day, massage therapist Tomoatsu Naoe is assigned an odd patient. This stunning woman was raised in a forest, and she has pointed ears and emerald eyes, everything about her suggests that she is an "elf". She seems to have left her world, but she still enjoys all the junk food that in humans world, and now her obsession is making it difficult for her to go back home. Is it possible for Tomoatsu Naoe to assist this endearing elf girl in losing weight and keeping it off?
episodeTitles: The Dark Elf and the Beautiful Flower
The Heat Oni and the Green Scales

278718.title: Quality Assurance in Another World
278718.evaluate: The island of Clayborne, though it lies far south of the continent of Felnarc, is actually composed of five small nations that are incessantly at odds with one another. A girl named Nikola lives a modest life in a small village in the most remote parts of the Kingdom of Bayle, the island's smallest and most tranquil nation. She is going about her daily business of gathering firewood when she is confronted one day by a large dragon, a species thought to only exist in the highest alpine regions. The village is about to be attacked when a man by the name of Haga dashes into view. Haga is a member of the top-secret investigative team known as the King's Seekers. After meeting Haga, Nikola is so captivated by him and his travels that she decides to venture out on her own and discover the real nature of her world. Despite the fact that every day is essentially the same, Nikola has never once felt bored with her peaceful life...

278720.title: CAGED CHARACTER
278720.evaluate: Suddenly, Fei Xingkong and Si Rui discovered that they were confined to a comic book cage. Their desire was to return to the real world. But in the world of stories that never stops changing, they were forced to escape the total control of the "author"...

278721.title: My Three-Body
278721.evaluate: Dr. Cheng Xin, an aerospace specialist, oversaw the Ladder Plan for active reconnaissance of the Three-Body fleet and launched Yun Tianming's donated brain into space in order to combat the impending invasion of Earth by the Three-Body people. Cheng Xin went into hibernation after discovering that Yun Tianming had given her a star and had loved her all her life. After waking up two centuries later, Cheng Xin gave the star to the United Nations, which led to her being chosen as the sword bearer to thwart the Three-Body. However, her generosity provoked the Three-Body to launch a full-scale attack, putting human civilization in jeopardy...

278722.title: Fabulous Beasts 4
278722.evaluate: Pipi, a legendary beast from ancient mythology, made his way to human civilization. He ran away to the deer shop that his friend Si Buxiang, who specialized in aiding mythological beasts, opened to avoid being persecuted by humans. In addition, he got to know a collection of mythological creatures with various personalities from all over the world, and he started leading a laid-back lifestyle far from people. And now let's see what will happen in season 4!

278723.title: Into the Mortal World
278723.evaluate: The anime tells the tale of a god who is in charge of "herding stars" and his mischievous sister. This anime creatively connects weaving with the celestial bodies above, retaining the mythological aspects of traditional Chinese culture while also introducing some new ideas.

278724.title: WIND BREAKER (Thai Dub)
278724.evaluate: Haruka Sakura is only interested in the most powerful of the strong; he has no desire to connect with weaklings. He recently enrolled in Furin High School, a filthy educational institution defined exclusively by physical prowess, which they use to deter evildoers from their town. But Haruka only wants to fight his way to the top; he doesn't care about being a hero or a member of any group!

278725.title: The Magical Girl and The Evil Lieutenant Used to Be Archenemies
278725.evaluate:
Everything is destroyed by the Evil Organization's invasion. This is the ruthless and crafty lieutenant, the king's right-hand man and the brains behind the operation. The magical girl Byakuya, cursed, is the one responsible for fending off the invasion of Earth. The evil lieutenant Mira is meant to confront the girl, but instead she unexpectedly falls in love at first sight.
This is the tale of the once-enemy magical girl and the evil lieutenant. What would happen to the couple as they refuse to kill as well as love each other?
278725.seasonTitle: The Magical Girl and The Evil Lieutenant Used to Be Archenemies
episodeTitles: I Can’t Kill Her (Out of Love)
(The Mission to Defeat) That Magical Girl Is Mine (Not for Anyone)

278726.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines!
278726.evaluate:
"Losing heroine" refers to a girl who was not chosen to be her beloved's girlfriend.

Anna Yanami, the gluttonous childhood friend style heroine.
Lemon Yakishio, the vibrant sports style heroine.
Chika Komari, the shy and endearing animal-style heroine.

Become entangled with those somewhat tragic losing heroines,
and here starts a brand-new, chaotic tale about youth!
The losing heroines, just shine in your defeat!
episodeTitles: Childhood Friend Expert, Anna Yanami Lost
Brought to You, the Promised Failure
Already Lost Before the Battle Begins

278727.title: The Richest Man in Game (Thai Dub)
278727.evaluate: A special reporter recently held an exclusive interview with Tenda Group President Pei Qian. Tenda Group's present capitalization exceeds $100 billion, and its operations span games, the Internet, digital devices, cultural media, catering, and other industries that have drastically altered people's lives. However, when questioned by reporters, Pei Qian stated, "I'm not a business wizard."My achievement is entirely due to chance! My initial goal was to simply lose 50,000 yuan. That's all..."
278727.seasonTitle: The Richest Man in Game (Thai Dub)

278728.title: Delico's Nursery
278728.evaluate:
Dali Delico, an aristocrat from the prestigious Delico family and a promising elite member of the Blood Pact Council, faces a significant mission assigned by the Council, the highest governing body of vampires. However, Dali bluntly refuses the task.

Frustrated, his fellow council members, Gerhard, Dino, and Henrique, visit him and try to persuade him, only to find Dali himself caring for a young child.

Meanwhile, a series of mysterious murders targeting vampires are happening in the streets. 
There appears to be a past connection between Dali and the anti-social organization Pendulum, believed to be behind these crimes...

"With all our blood and pride, let's prove that we can balance and achieve both duty and childcare!"

This is a story of the noblesse oblige childcare struggles of vampire aristocrats. 

Can the grand Gothic world coexist with the chaotic but proud act of raising children!?

Although the majority of them demonstrate remarkable abilities with S-rank, A-rank, and so forth, Mimori only possesses an E-rank, the lowest rank. Mimori is banished to a dungeon where there is almost no chance of survival because the goddess believes he is useless. But as it happens, his abilities are more unusual than they first appear to be. Then, this insignificant adolescent decides to take revenge on the goddess with giving up his nature.
278735.seasonTitle: Failure Frame: I Became the Strongest and Annihilated Everything With Low-Level Spells (Thai Dub)

278737.evaluate:
Because of a mistake that God made, Takumi Kayano lost his life and was reincarnated.
After being endowed with a variety of abilities, he was transported to a different planet and dropped into a perilous forest rife with monsters.
Takumi finds a young child and girl in the forest who look to be twins. He names them Alan and Elena and takes them under his protection. Astonished by the ease with which the two vanquish monsters with their martial arts prowess, Takumi arrives in town and joins the adventurer's guild in order to support himself.
He thus takes care of Alan and Elena as they grow up and begin a carefree life filled with adventures!
278737.seasonTitle: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring (Thai Dub)

278738.seasonTitle: A Journey Through Another World: Raising Kids While Adventuring (Dub Indo)

278739.title: DAN DA DAN
278739.evaluate:
Born into a family of mediums, high school girl Momo Ayase and her classmate, the occult maniac Takakura Ken, start talking after Momo helps Ken out of a bullying situation in class. However, they quickly find themselves in a heated argument—Momo, who believes in ghosts but denies the existence of aliens, and Ken, who believes in aliens but is skeptical about ghosts.

To prove the existence of what the other denies, Momo decides to visit an abandoned hospital known as a UFO hotspot, while Ken heads to a haunted tunnel. There, both of them encounter overwhelming supernatural phenomena beyond their comprehension. In the midst of this crisis, Momo awakens her hidden powers, and Ken gains the power of a curse, allowing them to face the approaching horrors together. And perhaps, a fated romance begins as well!?

Thus begins their occult battle and youth story!
episodeTitles: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know!
That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!
It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!

278740.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3
278740.evaluate:
A year has passed since the liberation of the "Sanctuary," where Subaru Natsuki fended off Elsa and her relentless attacks and fulfilled a contract with Beatrice in the battle against the Great Rabbit. The Emilia camp, united and strengthened, was enjoying peaceful days as they prepared for the Royal Selection. However, this peace was abruptly shattered by the arrival of a single letter delivered by a messenger. The letter was an invitation addressed to Emilia from Anastasia, one of the Royal Selection candidates, inviting them to Priestella, one of Lugnica's five major cities, known as the Watergate City.

Accepting the invitation, Subaru and his companions set out for Priestella, where they were met with various reunions: one unexpected, one unintended, and one inevitable. Beneath the surface, malicious forces were stirring, and an unprecedented crisis loomed over them. Once again, the boy must face a harsh and unforgiving fate.
278740.seasonTitle: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 3
episodeTitles: The Showdown of Ice and Fire

278741.title: Roommates
278741.evaluate: Bai Junyan, a girl with a delicate charm and pure demeanor, like a gentle white lotus, and Luo Ben, with her sophisticated elegance and high standards, a true socialite. These two drama queens end up sharing the same dorm and joining the same drama club. Then, they meet Gao Shu, a cool and distant sophomore heartthrob, and his mysteriously introverted roommate, Ou Yang. With all the key players now on stage, will they reveal their true selves and build genuine connections, or will they engage in a dramatic campus showdown full of intrigue and rivalry?

278744.title: Senpai is an Otokonoko
278744.evaluate:
Makoto Hanaoka is a boy who loves cute things and often dresses up as a girl, frequently appearing in school in a feminine guise. One day after school, something unexpected happens: Saki Aoi, a junior who has always mistaken him for a girl, suddenly confesses her love to him. In response to her heartfelt confession, Makoto honestly reveals, "Actually, I'm a boy." However, this rejection doesn't deter Saki; instead, she becomes even more determined, declaring, "I like you, whether you're a boy or a girl!" and boldly proclaiming, "I want to be your first love!"
Meanwhile, Makoto's childhood friend and closest companion, Ryuuji Taiga, quietly stays by his side, secretly harboring feelings for him.
The three of them form an intriguing yet slightly bittersweet romantic drama, as they embark on a poignant story about love, friendship, and growth.

278746.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets＊
278746.evaluate: The five beautiful sisters, who once faced the risk of repeating a grade and hated studying, were eventually able to "graduate" successfully with the help of their part-time tutor, Futaro. Although each sister has started pursuing her own dreams, they all seem to have some worries. At this time, Futaro and the sisters planned a honeymoon-like trip to Hawaii. However, just as the trip was about to go smoothly, a certain event was suddenly exposed, throwing everyone into chaos! To make matters worse, during their trip to Hawaii, they also got caught up in various troubles…!?
